description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log functionality, enabling logging with additional features like chaining log nodes and formatting log output. The class provides methods to set and get the next log node and to output log messages to both Android's log system and the next chain node.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to facilitate chained logging and additional processing.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain for subsequent logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message to Android's log system and forwards it to the next node in the chain if available.
